nodes.label: Ripple escrow owner accounts r9UUEX…HiYp and rB3WNZ…scPn

competing_hypotheses.statement: Bithomp's account pages are stale or incomplete and omit current escrow objects/transactions.
support: r9 page says active 6 months ago and no transactions; rB3 page also says no transactions despite XRP Insights listing October 1 EscrowFinish hashes.
disconfirming: Bithomp page is a separate public explorer and explicitly reports no escrow objects for both addresses.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Query raw account_objects and account_tx at ledger #108031214 and a fresh validated ledger.

competing_hypotheses.statement: XRP Insights may have a wallet attribution, ledger parsing or page-generation error.
support: Bithomp's public pages do not show escrow objects on the named accounts.
disconfirming: XRP Insights documents a pinned validated ledger, direct rippled JSON-RPC account_objects/account_tx method and provides October 1 transaction hashes.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Verify each escrow ledger object index, Owner, Destination, Amount, FinishAfter and transaction metadata directly against XRPL nodes.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The explorer page may show only liquid account balance while omitting escrow objects because of cache, rendering or indexing scope.
support: The pages show 500M XRP balance and stale activity labels.
disconfirming: The page explicitly says no escrow objects, so omission cannot be assumed without raw evidence.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Compare Bithomp raw transaction/object API with public rippled JSON-RPC at the same ledger.

limitations: The source conflict does not prove escrow deletion, release or a changed November schedule.
Do not classify the scheduled 1B as sell pressure.
No directional forecast or feature admission.
